## Declarations and implementations

```plato

// Planar Gabor noise: sparse convolution of oriented Gabor kernels, giving
// direct spectral control. Orientation sets the dominant stripe direction;
// Bandwidth sets kernel falloff; Anisotropy in [0, 1] blends from isotropic
// (0) to fully oriented (1)
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gabor_filter).
type GaborNoise2D
    implements IValue, IScalarField2D
{
    Seed: Integer;
    Frequency: Number;
    Orientation: Angle;
    Bandwidth: Number;
    Anisotropy: Number;
}

// Spatial Gabor noise: sparse convolution of oriented Gabor kernels, giving
// direct spectral control. Direction sets the dominant oscillation axis;
// Bandwidth sets kernel falloff; Anisotropy in [0, 1] blends from isotropic
// (0) to fully oriented (1)
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gabor_filter).
type GaborNoise3D
    implements IValue, IScalarField3D
{
    Seed: Integer;
    Frequency: Number;
    Direction: Direction3D;
    Bandwidth: Number;
    Anisotropy: Number;
}

//==
// # Fractal noises
//
// Multi-octave sums of a basis noise. Octaves counts the layers; each octave
// multiplies frequency by Lacunarity (typically 2) and amplitude by Gain
// (typically 0.5).

// Planar fractal Brownian motion: a sum of Octaves layers of the Basis noise
// with geometrically scaled frequency and amplitude. The workhorse for
// terrain, clouds, and natural textures
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fractional_Brownian_motion).
type FbmNoise2D
    implements IValue, IScalarField2D
{
    Basis: NoiseBasis;
    Seed: Integer;
    Frequency: Number;
    Octaves: Integer;
    Lacunarity: Number;
    Gain: Number;
}

// Spatial fractal Brownian motion: a sum of Octaves layers of the Basis noise
// with geometrically scaled frequency and amplitude. The workhorse for
// terrain, clouds, and natural textures
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fractional_Brownian_motion).
type FbmNoise3D
    implements IValue, IScalarField3D
{
    Basis: NoiseBasis;
    Seed: Integer;
    Frequency: Number;
    Octaves: Integer;
    Lacunarity: Number;
    Gain: Number;
}

// Planar turbulence: fractal Brownian motion summing absolute values of each
// octave. Non-negative, with a billowy, cloud-like character and creases at
// the basis zero crossings.
type TurbulenceNoise2D
    implements IValue, IScalarField2D
{
    Basis: NoiseBasis;
    Seed: Integer;
    Frequency: Number;
    Octaves: Integer;
    Lacunarity: Number;
    Gain: Number;
}

// Spatial turbulence: fractal Brownian motion summing absolute values of each
// octave. Non-negative, with a billowy, cloud-like character and creases at
// the basis zero crossings.
type TurbulenceNoise3D
    implements IValue, IScalarField3D
{
    Basis: NoiseBasis;
    Seed: Integer;
    Frequency: Number;
    Octaves: Integer;
    Lacunarity: Number;
    Gain: Number;
}

// Planar ridged multifractal noise: octaves of inverted absolute basis noise
// offset by Offset (typically 1), producing sharp ridge lines. Suited to
// mountainous terrain and lightning-like filaments
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Multifractal_system).
type RidgedNoise2D
    implements IValue, IScalarField2D
{
    Basis: NoiseBasis;
    Seed: Integer;
    Frequency: Number;
    Octaves: Integer;
    Lacunarity: Number;
    Gain: Number;
    Offset: Number;
}

// Spatial ridged multifractal noise: octaves of inverted absolute basis noise
// offset by Offset (typically 1), producing sharp ridge crests. Suited to
// mountainous terrain and vein-like structures
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Multifractal_system).
type RidgedNoise3D
    implements IValue, IScalarField3D
{
    Basis: NoiseBasis;
    Seed: Integer;
    Frequency: Number;
    Octaves: Integer;
    Lacunarity: Number;
    Gain: Number;
    Offset: Number;
}

//==
// # Warped and derived noises
//
// Noise fields built by feeding one noise through another: domain warping
// displaces the sample position before evaluation, and curl noise takes the
// rotational derivative of a smooth potential to obtain a divergence-free
// vector field.

// Planar domain-warped noise: the sample point is displaced by a warp noise
// of WarpFrequency scaled by WarpStrength, applied Iterations times, before
// evaluating the Basis noise. Produces marbled, fluid-like patterns.
type DomainWarpNoise2D
    implements IValue, IScalarField2D
{
    Basis: NoiseBasis;
    Seed: Integer;
    Frequency: Number;
    WarpStrength: Number;
    WarpFrequency: Number;
    Iterations: Integer;
}
```
